flags.why: “Hoa lá” does not mean a fling or dalliance; this confuses it with “trăng hoa”.

flags.headword: hoa nhài cắm bãi cứt trâu
flags.why: The expression insults the woman's partner by comparing him to buffalo dung and needs a derogatory warning.

The common literal meaning is a whorl-shaped fingerprint, which people count when discussing how many hoa tay someone has ([literary example](https://vnthuquan.net/TacPham/toi-thay-hoa-vang-tren-co-xanh-15740/chuong-1)).
flags.fix: noun | whorl-shaped fingerprint on a fingertip

flags.why: “Dấu hoa thị” remains a current term for an asterisk, including in [Ministry of Education materials](https://moet.gov.vn/content/vanban/Lists/VBDH/Attachments/3584/hoc-phan-7full16012024-3173525.pdf), so calling it dated is misleading.
flags.fix: Remove the dated tag and gloss it as “asterisk”.
